# asyntai_website (Data Source)

One website (AI agent): its widget id, embed code and whether its setup jobs are done.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "asyntai_website" "shop" {
  id = "42"
}

output "shop_embed_code" {
  value = data.asyntai_website.shop.embed_code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Website id.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) Domain.
- `embed_code` (String) The `<script>` snippet to put on the site.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary website.
- `knowledge_items` (Number) Number of knowledge base items.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `ready` (Boolean) `true` when no site reading or instruction writing is still running.
- `widget_id` (String) Widget id.
